description: This file declares the DirectoryLister class and related components for asynchronously listing directory contents, including delegate interface and internal core class, within the net namespace.

classes.name: DirectoryLister
classes.description: Provides an API for asynchronously listing directory contents, managing delegate callbacks, and controlling the listing process.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::DirectoryListerData
classes.description: Struct representing a file found during directory listing, including file info and paths.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::DirectoryListerDelegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving directory entries and completion notification.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::Core
classes.description: Ref-counted internal class responsible for directory retrieval and sorting on a worker thread.

methods.name: DirectoryLister
methods.description: Constructor initializing the directory lister with path, optional listing type, and delegate.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Stops directory enumeration asynchronously, preventing delegate callbacks.
